**The Census**

Previously: Decennial Census (long form) = 10 years, 10 questions
Now: American Commmunity Survey (ACS) = created in 2005, 3% of households are surveyed (this sample is used to come up with estimate for population)

3 Types of ACS
1. 1-year ACS 
Less than 65k places are surveyed, making it fairly useless!

2. 3-year ACS 
Dead! Doesn't exist anymore!

3. 5-year ACS
This is the one we use. Five year average.

## Proving R Works

The chunk below runs when this page renders. If you can see a result underneath
it on your published site, R and Quarto are talking to each other correctly.


::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
sessionInfo()$R.version$version.string
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
[1] "R version 4.6.1 (2026-06-24)"
```


:::
:::


**What happens after you render a page?**

1. The file is read from top to bottom.
2. Finds code chunks.
3. Sends them to R, gets results back.
4. Gives text and results into HTML.
